coverage.municipality: Municipality of the County of Victoria
coverage.notes: All twelve result rows were visually reviewed and included, one carrying two PIDs. coverage.municipality: Municipality of the County of Victoria
coverage.event: March 24, 2026 tax sale by public auction
coverage.notes: Fifteen result rows were visually reviewed; five are included. coverage.municipality: Cape Breton Regional Municipality
coverage.notes: The owner-free notice carries 67 records covering 68 exact PIDs. CBRM's official result PDF carries 54 identifier-bearing rows: 21 print numeric winning bids and are included as sold, one prints PAID AT SALE and 32 print no winning bid or disposition, so those 33 remain outcome unknown. Thirteen notice rows do not appear in the result PDF and also remain unknown. The assessed-name column was discarded before the repository dataset was written. No outcome depends on yellow table highlighting: numeric winning bids are printed for every included sold row, while the PAID AT SALE row is also highlighted and remains unknown.

coverage.municipality: Cape Breton Regional Municipality
coverage.event: July 22, 2025 tax sale by public auction
coverage.notes: The re-downloaded result PDF re-hashed to the recorded receipt, and all 74 rows were reconciled against the rendered pages rather than extracted text alone. The table fills outcome-bearing rows in yellow, but that fill is redundant with the printed WINNING BID column on every one of the 74 rows, so no disposition depends on visual emphasis; this is what separates it from the March 10, 2026 result. Seventy-three rows are included: 50 publish a winning bid, one prints REDEEMED, and 22 stay outcome-unknown (five PAID AT SALE, four WALKED AWAY, and thirteen rows printing no winning bid at all). PAID AT SALE is not read as a completed sale because the official wording does not distinguish a bidder paying at the sale from the account being paid to stop it. Lien 25-178 (AAN 2210363, PID 15440050) is excluded because the live NSPRD service returns no parcel for that PID; it is itemized in the match-exceptions file. CBRM removed its pre-sale notice PDFs when the site migrated, and the notice was never archived, so the notice receipt is the official CBRM tax-sales page captured on 2025-07-14, which pins the July 22, 2025 11:00 a.m. in-person public auction at Centre 200, Sydney and links the maps and descriptions for liens 25-97 to 25-217. The assessed-name column was discarded before the repository dataset was written.

coverage.municipality: Cape Breton Regional Municipality
coverage.notes: On July 30, 2026, the CBRM landing page linked a July 27 replacement PDF at a new official URL; the previously recorded March URL returned 404. The replacement carries 44 identifier-bearing rows and no printed result, disposition, or winning-bid column. Some rows are highlighted yellow, but colour alone is not an accepted disposition, so no outcome is inferred and the event remains outside the public model. The prior document hash is retained as a provenance receipt for the replaced official file.

coverage.municipality: Municipality of the County of Cumberland
coverage.event: October 21, 2025 tax sale by public auction
coverage.notes: All twenty result rows were visually reviewed and included; nineteen publish a winning bid and one publishes NOT COMPLETED with no amount and stays outcome-unknown. The live municipal page is overwritten each sale and no longer carries this table, so both receipts are archive captures of that same address; the two captures were parsed independently and agree row-for-row. No pre-sale notice for this sale survives in the archive, so notice-to-result reconciliation was impossible. The assessed-name column was discarded before the repository dataset was written.

coverage.municipality: Municipality of the County of Cumberland
coverage.event: March 3, 2026 tax sale by public auction
coverage.notes: All fourteen result rows were visually reviewed and included; eight publish a winning bid and six publish ADJORNED, recorded as withdrawn with no bid. Three independent copies agree row-for-row: the April 15 and May 9, 2026 archive captures and a live retrieval on July 23, 2026 whose SHA-256 is the third hash listed here. The page was also submitted to the Wayback Machine on July 23, 2026; that capture replays the results table, but its raw archived payload is a bot-verification interstitial rather than the page, so it is cited as a durable link only and is not hashed. The assessed-name column was discarded before the repository dataset was written.

coverage.municipality: Municipality of the County of Cumberland
coverage.notes: The archive holds pre-sale notice tables for both sales, two properties for January 14, 2025 and thirty-two for March 18, 2025, but no capture of either result table exists because Cumberland overwrites its single tax-sale page and no crawl landed between those sales and the next overwrite. Notice-only rows are held out of the published dataset under the same fail-closed rule applied elsewhere. Several March 18, 2025 parcels reappear with published results in the included October 21, 2025 and March 3, 2026 events.

coverage.municipality: Municipality of the District of Lunenburg
coverage.notes: 27 advertised listings were reconciled from the official tender package to the municipality's per-property award documents. 16 sold with a winning bid read from the award document, Two received no bids, Seven were withdrawn, and Two have no published award document and are published with an unknown outcome rather than an inferred one. MODL publishes assessment account numbers but no PIDs, so every PID was derived by matching the account's PVSC coordinate against the NSPRD parcel layer. Assessed-owner and bidder identities carried on both surfaces were deliberately omitted from this public dataset. The award document for item 60 prints assessment account 03191477 and item 31 shows the sale awarded then withdrawn by both bidders; item 229's award document and the surplus record disagree on the final price. These are recorded but not published as winning bids.
